Class ConfigService

java.lang.Object
ecmwf.ecpds.master.plugin.http.services.config.ConfigService
public class ConfigService extends Object
ConfigService.java This is the common configuration service for the framework. It will load ALL the ".properties" files in the "configDirectory" directory and put them into different sets of properties, for all the applications to use. Every config file should be loaded from this mechanism. Created: Tue Apr 23 16:06:33 2002
Version:
1.0
Author:
Daniel Varela Santoalla

  • Constructor Details

    • ConfigService

      public ConfigService()
      Creates a new ConfigService instance. It will be called at the class loading time. Please note that this is the only service that DOESN'T use the LogService, since it is a prerrequisite for LogService to work. The log output will be shown in "stderr".

  • Method Details

    • init

      public static void init(String base, String dir) throws ConfigException
      This method is called from the bootstrap servlet ConfigBootstrapServlet. It should be noted that different "static" instances of ConfigService need to exist in every webapp, so the ConfigBootstrapServlet definition with " invalid input: '<'load-on-startup>1 invalid input: '<'/load-on-startup>" option should be present onj every web.xml file using this classes. The lack of doing this will result on a NULL POINTER exception.
      Parameters:
      base - The directory where webapp is installed.
      dir - The relative subdirectory where we have all the configuration files.
      Throws:
      ConfigException - The dir supplied is bad or a problem happened when trying to open a file.

    • getParameter

      public static String getParameter(String name) throws ConfigException
      Returns a String value for a configuration parameter. It will take the first component of the parameter (till the first point) as the "set" name, and will try to find the rest of the parameter inside that set.
      Parameters:
      name - The param name
      Returns:
      The String param value
      Throws:
      ConfigException - The parameter was not found.

    • getCollectionParameter

      public static Collection getCollectionParameter(String set, String name) throws ConfigException
      Returns a Collection value for a configuration parameter. The parameter value is expected to be comma-separated string. The Collection returned will have as many components as the comma-separated string.
      Parameters:
      set - The configuration set name.
      name - The param name.
      Returns:
      The Collection param value
      Throws:
      ConfigException - The parameter was not found.
